title: 1x896 channel-selector polarity: the task stream is authoritative, and libane was guessing
verdict: The ANEC header never states which tile channel carries input 0 or output 0. libane assumed a positional order (dst = 4 + i, src = 4 + dst_count + i), which is the order mil-hwxc normalizes Apple's selectors into, not a property of the format. The task descriptor carries the real map in its own selector word. Deriving it from there fixes the 1x896 destination polarity on hardware and is a proven no-op on the already-qualified 64-element class. Two further defects in the same exported family still stood between a correct engine result and a correct host result; both are now named, byte-level located, and each individually proven on device.

decision.question: Apple's task bytes select src1 = ch 4, src2 = ch 1, dst = ch 5. libane hardcodes dst = 4, src = 5. Which side is authoritative?
decision.answer: The task descriptor. The engine reads and writes the channels its own task names; the ANEC header's tiles[] and nchw[] are indexed by the same channel number and the driver binds handles[bdx] to channel bdx, so the numbering is shared end to end. The only free variable is the role order, and the header does not carry it. libane's positional formula was therefore an unsourced assumption, and it is the defect.
decision.why_libane_and_not_the_converter: libane owns the host-facing ane_send(nn, x, idx) / ane_read(nn, y, idx) API and is the only layer that sees both the task bytes and the caller's role index. Fixing it corrects every already-exported artifact with no re-export. Fixing the converter would only correct future exports and would leave libane still asserting a convention nothing states.
decision.ordering_rule: Roles are ordered by ascending channel number, not by selector field position. The two proven H13 artifacts carry the three selector fields in opposite order (words[8] = 0x00024966 gives fields 6,5,4 and 0x000249a5 gives 5,6,4) while both place the destination on channel 4 with sources on 5 and 6. Field position therefore carries no role; the channel number does, and ascending order reproduces libane's previous behaviour exactly on every proven artifact.

contract_decoded.reserved_channels: below 4: 0 is the command channel, 1 is the kernel BAR a folded constant blob reads through, 3 is scratch
contract_decoded.destination_discriminator: the channel, not the configuration word. A fused chain's in-flight result keeps its destination selector on channel 0 and stays in L2, so only a destination naming an allocated surface channel is the model's output. 0x000000c0, 0x000000c1 and 0x040000c1 all appear on real output writes across the decoded encoders; an earlier draft that accepted only 0x040000c1 wrongly rejected the real output write of tile_r, reduce_mean, reduce_probe_max and select_rrb.
contract_decoded.multi_task_walk: word 7 of each descriptor is the next descriptor's stream offset; bits 16:24 of word 1 of the CURRENT descriptor are the NEXT descriptor's word count less one. Reading the word count from the next descriptor instead of the current one silently broke every multi-task program (60 of 25,087 fell back), which is how the bug was caught.
provenance: mil-hwx-compiler plugins/H13/H13ANEC.cpp:118-131 (bindTasks writes the same three fields)

static_regression.corpus: 25087 ANEC files from 164 programs compiled locally with mil-hwx-compiler 83d486b1 (build/mil-hwxc), spanning 122 oracle families plus a hand-authored elementwise spread
static_regression.tool: omarchy-ane test/bind/main.out, the shipped derivation itself, not a reimplementation

differences.task_evidence: 6 descriptors; t0 reads ch4 (0x13800 = 0x00033881), t1 reads ch5, t5 writes ch6 (0x17800 = 0x040000c1). No other tile DMA is enabled.
differences.reading: A genuine second instance of the same defect, found by the derivation. floor_div_native is Apple's own captured task stream replayed verbatim (mil-hwx-compiler receipts/2026-09-13-batched-oracle-mint-round2/RECEIPT.md:134-142) and was never normalized into the positional order, so it is mis-bound on device today: the host would feed its output tile and read a tile the engine never wrote. It has no device receipt claiming exactness.
differences.residual: Which of ch4 and ch5 is operand x versus operand y is not established. floor_div is not commutative, so the ascending-order assignment is unverified for this family. Needs a device check with distinguishable operands.

fallbacks.cause: Batched matmul with two runtime operands reads its second operand through the coefficient DMA (0x1f800), not the tile DMA, so the three tile selectors name only one of the two sources the header counts. Channel 6 is allocated (tiles[6] = 36) and never appears in an enabled tile selector.
fallbacks.effect: The count check fails and the positional layout stands, which is the binding these device-proven artifacts already use. Mapping a coefficient-DMA base address back to a channel index would require the driver's BAR assignment, which the host does not have at bind time.

coupling_to_the_td_size_fix.observation: Run the derivation over the exported bundles as shipped, with the stale td_size = 0x274, and all four fall back to the positional layout.
coupling_to_the_td_size_fix.cause: The declared descriptor length is the walk's bound for task 0. At 0x274 the register-record walk runs 124 bytes past the 0x1f8 task into the CoreML weight-blob header and hits the guard, exactly as the engine did when it returned -110.
coupling_to_the_td_size_fix.consequence: The channel derivation only works once td_size is truthful. The two fixes are ordered, not independent: ane-linux-experiments 8e89936 first, then this one.

fix_1x896.derived_map: src=4 dst=5; positional was src=5 dst=4
fix_1x896.result: No -110. ane_exec = 0, elapsed_ms = 2. The engine wrote channel 5, the derived destination: every runtime surface was pre-seeded with a per-channel sentinel and the 896 words of channel 5 came back written while the rest of its 64 KiB tile kept the sentinel. Channel 4, the derived source, came back holding exactly the input the host wrote. The destination polarity is fixed.
fix_1x896.values_still_wrong_and_exactly_explained: Output was 1.0 for elements 0-63 and 1.25 for elements 64-895. That is bit-for-bit equal to 1.0 + kernel_section[i] over all 896 elements, including the two odd values -0.7333984375 and -426.25 produced by the 0xDEADBEEF record at words 32-33. Nothing in the result is unexplained.

residual_1_kernel_section_offset.defect: The ANEC's kernel section is weights.bin[0x00:0x700], byte-identical. The CoreML blob payload starts at 0x80 (a 0x40 header plus a 0x40 0xDEADBEEF blob record), so the first 64 fp16 coefficients the engine reads are the blob header and the last 64 real coefficients are truncated.
residual_1_kernel_section_offset.located: kernel section at ANEC offset 0x1000 + align16(tsk_size) = 0x1200, krn_size = 0x700. The converter sources it from the HWX __TEXT,__const, which for a BLOBFILE constant carries the blob file bytes including that header (tools/hwxv2-to-anec.py:207,236-238,259).
residual_1_kernel_section_offset.proof: Relocating the section to weights.bin[0x80:0x780], same size, no other byte changed: all 896 outputs became 0x3d00 = 1.25 exactly. anec sha256 3adeb990bdbd9ad5e023cde5113f79c48287ada548849c2cba6631f7e60d5f52.
residual_1_kernel_section_offset.owner: The export path. Coefficients must come from the blob payload offset, not from byte 0 of the blob file. Not fixed here: it is a distinct defect requiring the blob-header format work, and the durable fix belongs with whoever owns the exporter.

residual_2_header_geometry.defect: The exported ANEC declares nchw[4] = nchw[5] = (1,896,1,1,64,64), the 64-byte-padded plane convention. Its own task DMA is configured for a dense surface: registers 0x13810, 0x13814, 0x13818, 0x17810 and 0x17814 all read 1792 = 896 x 2.
residual_2_header_geometry.measured_contrast: The proven mil-hwxc 64-element program reads 0x13810 = 64 with 0x13814 = 0x13818 = 4096 = 64 x 64, which does match its (1,64,1,1,64,64) header. So the convention is per-program and the task is again authoritative.
residual_2_header_geometry.effect: mlx-omarchy packs and unpacks at a plane stride taken from nchw[4] (overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/ane/runtime_detail.h:158-186), so it scattered the input across 64-byte rows and gathered the output from 64-byte rows, while the engine moved 1792 contiguous bytes. Measured directly: the engine wrote exactly words 0-895 of the destination tile and nothing beyond.
residual_2_header_geometry.proof: Correcting nchw[4] and nchw[5] to (1,896,1,1,2,2) and the matching manifest bindings, on top of residual 1: mlx-omarchy-ane-worker reported "verified output t2 exact", status 0, iterations 1, elapsed_ms 1. anec sha256 1a6953527033997aaa45ba91c65db00d2a76858b3418df8ced369682502fc620.
residual_2_header_geometry.owner: The export path, same as residual 1. nchw must be derived from the task's tile-DMA byte counts rather than stamped from a convention.

device.end_to_end: With the derived channel binding plus both named residuals corrected, the 1x896 add is exact end to end through the real runtime: verified output t2 exact, 1 ms. Only the channel binding is fixed in source here; the two residuals were proven by byte-level correction of the artifact.

vacuous_validator.finding: mlx-omarchy overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/ane/bundle.cpp:274-280 defines output_bdx(i) = 4 + i and input_bdx(header, i) = 4 + destination_count + i, and validate_binding rejects a manifest whose declared channel differs. The adapted schema-4 manifest for 1x896 declares input channel 5 and output channel 4 -- those same formulas -- so the check compares a number to the formula that produced it and cannot fail.
vacuous_validator.consequence: The manifest's declared channels are wrong for this artifact (the truth is input 4, output 5) and the validator cannot notice. The runtime is unaffected because it drives libane purely by role index (runtime_worker.cpp:207-215,300-335), which is why the libane fix alone corrected the device behaviour.
vacuous_validator.required_follow_up: Point output_bdx/input_bdx at the derived map so the manifest's declaration is checked against the task stream. This cannot land alone: every existing schema-4 manifest declares formula-derived channels and would be rejected until re-adapted. Not attempted here -- mlx-omarchy was under concurrent edit by three peers during this slice and no source file in it was touched.

cross_agent.select_island_ruled_out: IslandsExecJwm1 and IslandsExecJw16 both reported the 8-head select island returning corrupted passthrough lanes (1341 and 1337 per head, H rows 0-8, cond all-false). select_rrb_1x8x375x375 derives src=5,6,7 dst=4, identical to the positional map, so its binding is correct today and unchanged by this fix. That defect is the already-named h13.select-first-l2-tile hole, not channel polarity.
cross_agent.select_bypass_correction: EncoderParityAne planned to justify skipping the select island on the grounds that the clip's cond is all-false. That premise is wrong on its own: the corruption is in the passthrough and is independent of cond content. The bypass is valid only because the select runs on the GPU in that plan, so the hole is outside the execution path. Agreed and recorded with the agent.

residual_1_kernel_section_offset.observe_without_hardware: kernel section offset = 0x1000 + ((tsk_size + 15) & ~15) = 0x1200; krn_size = 0x700. model.anec[0x1200:0x1900] is byte-identical to weights.bin[0x0000:0x0700]. weights.bin is 0x780 bytes: a 0x40 header, a 0x40 0xDEADBEEF blob record, then 0x700 of payload at 0x80. So the coefficient stream the engine reads is 64 fp16 words of blob header followed by only the first 832 of the 896 real coefficients.
residual_1_kernel_section_offset.assert: sha256(model.anec[0x1200:0x1900]) matches sha256(weights.bin[0x0:0x700]), and model.anec[0x1200:0x1280] equals weights.bin[0x0:0x80]. Read as fp16, exactly 64 of the 896 coefficient words differ from 0.25 and they are indices 0-63; the only two of large magnitude are index 32 = -1.7333984375 and index 33 = -427.25, the 0xDEADBEEF record. The 0x700 window starting at 0x80 instead holds exactly one distinct fp16 value, 0x3400 = 0.25, repeated 896 times.
residual_1_kernel_section_offset.device_check: Overwrite model.anec[0x1200:0x1900] with weights.bin[0x80:0x780] -- same length, no other byte touched -- re-stamp the anec payload sha256 and release_asset.model_sha256, then submit once. Before: outputs are 1.0 for elements 0-63 and 1.25 for 64-895, and the whole 896-element result is bit-for-bit equal to fp16(1.0) + kernel_section[i], with elements 32 and 33 coming back as -0.7333984375 and -426.25. After: all 896 outputs are 0x3d00 = 1.25. Corrected anec sha256 3adeb990bdbd9ad5e023cde5113f79c48287ada548849c2cba6631f7e60d5f52, retained at /var/tmp/AneChannelPolarity-20260914/krnfix on jwm1.
residual_1_kernel_section_offset.where_the_converter_does_it: tools/hwxv2-to-anec.py takes the kernel section verbatim from the HWX __TEXT,__const (line 207 selects it, 236-238 bounds-check kernel_offset, 259 records kernel_size). For a BLOBFILE constant that section carries the blob file bytes including the header, so the converter must source coefficients from the blob payload offset rather than copying __const through. The payload offset is not a constant to hardcode: the MIL declares BLOBFILE(..., offset = uint64(64)) and the writer adds a further 0x40 record, so it has to be read out of the blob header.

residual_2_header_geometry.observe_without_hardware: Walk the task's register records and read the tile-DMA byte counts. Exported 1x896 task 0: 0x13810 = 0x13814 = 0x13818 = 0x17808 = 0x1780c = 0x17810 = 0x17814 = 1792 = 896 * 2, a dense surface. Its header declares nchw[4] = nchw[5] = (1,896,1,1,64,64), which is the 64-byte-padded plane convention. The proven mil-hwxc 64-element program (mil-hwx-compiler research/results/h13-base-m1-20260912-rung6/program-0.anec) instead reads 0x13810 = 64 with 0x13814 = 0x13818 = 0x17810 = 0x17814 = 4096 = 64 * 64, which does match its (1,64,1,1,64,64) header. Geometry is therefore per-program and the task is authoritative, exactly as the channel selectors are.
residual_2_header_geometry.why_it_matters_on_the_host: mlx-omarchy packed_element_offset (overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/ane/runtime_detail.h:158-186) computes element offset as plane * nchw[4] + row * nchw[5] + column * 2. With nchw[4] = 64 and H = W = 1 that is element * 64, so the host scattered the input across 64-byte rows and gathered the output from 64-byte rows while the engine moved 1792 contiguous bytes.
residual_2_header_geometry.direct_measurement: Sentinel-seed the whole 64 KiB destination tile, execute once, then read it back flat. The engine wrote exactly fp16 words 0 through 895 and nothing beyond; words 896 onward still held the sentinel, and every 32-word row of the first 896 words was uniformly 0x3d00. A 64-byte-strided write of 896 elements would instead have left 31 sentinels between consecutive values and touched 57344 bytes.
residual_2_header_geometry.device_check: On top of residual 1, set header nchw[4] and nchw[5] to (1,896,1,1,2,2) and the matching manifest programs[].inputs[].nchw / outputs[].nchw, re-stamp the hashes, submit once: mlx-omarchy-ane-worker reports "verified output t2 exact", status 0, 1 iteration, elapsed_ms 1. Corrected anec sha256 1a6953527033997aaa45ba91c65db00d2a76858b3418df8ced369682502fc620, retained at /var/tmp/AneChannelPolarity-20260914/geomfix on jwm1.
residual_2_header_geometry.header_field_offsets: struct anec is packed: size u64 at 0, td_size u32 at 8, td_count u32 at 12, tsk_size u64 at 16, krn_size u64 at 24, src_count u32 at 32, dst_count u32 at 36, tiles[32] u32 at 40, nchw[32][6] u64 at 168. So nchw[ch] starts at 168 + ch * 48.
residual_2_header_geometry.proposed_derivation: nchw plane and row bytes should come from the task's own destination and source DMA byte counts rather than from surface_layout()'s max(64, ...) rule (mil-hwx-compiler research/inspect_anec.py:145-154). For a [1,C,1,1] fp16 surface the dense case is plane = row = 2 and the padded case is plane = row = 64; the discriminator is whether the task's 0x13814 / 0x17814 equals C * 2 or C * 64.

reproduction_for_the_export_path_lane.ordering: Residual 1 alone makes the engine result exact but the worker still reports a mismatch, because the host layout is wrong independently. Residual 2 alone leaves the coefficients wrong. Both are needed for an exact end-to-end result, and both need td_size (8e89936) and the derived channel binding (20d24ad) underneath them.
